notes.title: 《Tiny Isle》August 2 Update Announcement v0.3.57
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have updated the game demo, and the details are as follows.



💻Balance Adjustments:

· Crystals can no longer ascend to non-existent levels.

· Unlock Web now uses total unlock count instead of achievements, with updated node visuals.

· Redesigned Unlock Web layout to reduce mid-game clicking frequency.

· Increased upgrade costs in mid-to-late game stages.

· Slightly increased the value growth rate of plants.

· Nerfed the stats of Magic Cactus.

· Enhanced the effect of Quake Succulent.

· Crystal level of Chorus Daffodil increased to Lv.5.

· Improved production interval of Giant Mushroom.

· Significantly raised the price of all Radishes and improved market volatility algorithm.

· Improved Four-Leaf Clover's transfer efficiency and reduced its price.

· Hive has been greatly empowered.



🎮Quality of Life:

· Major performance improvements across the game.

· Additional tutorial guides added.

· Fixed issue where settings could reset under certain conditions.

· Improved logic in the Fish Encyclopedia panel.

· Fixed bug causing Full-Heart Residents to duplicate.

· Shrubs now disperse naturally when the island expands.

· Improved fish spot refresh logic.

· Fixed bug preventing Crystal Cluster Flower from functioning.

· Fixed issue where Resident Boats wouldn’t disappear.

notes.title: 🌟Brand New Tiny Isle Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
After six months of hard work, Tiny Isle's new demo is now available on Steam again!
We’ve added tons of new content and polish—step into a livelier, cozier island world.
Here’s what’s new in this update:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295952/42c4dcb3b9fcc2f1498556617fef21e2711746cc.png"]
[hr][/hr]🏠 Resident System
Your island residents now walk around and interact with plants!
You can also recruit new residents via the treehole—each has unique looks, routines, and personalities.
Befriend them, and they’ll stay on the island permanently!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295952/f3276f2f54ae0b0b6fef474b6094d773ff44a87e.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🌸 More Crops
About 20 new crops have been added—producers, carriers, boosters, and special types.
We also restructured the crop unlock tree for a smoother progression,
and rebalanced crop behavior based on player feedback.


[hr][/hr]🐟 Fishing Overhaul
Fishing has been fully reworked!
We added legendary fish species, a size/value system, and a full fish encyclopedia.
Catch the rarest, biggest fish and become the island’s fishing master!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295952/87bf99eadae122a58a07630e1b99bb4638ce6498.png"]
[hr][/hr]🌧️ Weather Expansion
The weather system is now more dynamic, with new regular conditions and unique interactions.
You might even witness rare phenomena like jellyfish rain, meteor showers, or thick fog!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295952/f80d8a0f4a23607d1b51b7df56d2546b9937d3e2.png"]
[hr][/hr]⚙️ Quality-of-Life Improvements
We’ve added custom window size, fullscreen support, photo mode, and a toggle for crystal display.
These updates aim to make your experience smoother and more enjoyable than ever.


[hr][/hr]
💌 Come back to the island and enjoy the cozy adventure once again!

notes.title: 25.2.8 update
notes.notes:
Experience Optimizations:
! Selection frame added. This makes it clear which plot is currently selected.
! Fishing controls have been optimized for a more intuitive feel.
! To prevent lag, the auto-save feature has been temporarily disabled. A forced save will occur once upon exiting.
The shop's price sorting now displays in the correct order.
The "There are no vacancies around! " warning no longer appears during level-ups.

notes.title: 25.2.4 Update
notes.notes:
Value Adjustments:

！Increased the transportation efficiency of sprites.
！Added a click-triggered feature to clovers.
！Upgrading clovers will reduce the effect interval of certain abilities.
Adjusted the achievement unlock frequency in later stages. Slightly increased the difficulty of completing the later stages of the "Stone to Crystal," "Prosperous Island," and "Crystal Tycoon" achievement series, while slightly decreasing the difficulty of completing the later stages of the "Crop Cultivator," "Plant Expert," and "Lost Key" achievement series.

Experience Optimizations:
！Optimized the island expansion logic, no longer causing expansion amount shortages.
！Added support for ESC and WASD shortcut keys.
！Added support for 2K resolution.
！The shop bar will no longer automatically collapse.
！Added snow weather ambient sounds and optimized the day-night music switching logic.
！Optimized the mismatch issue with the crop information panel's value display.
Coin-operated Succulent will no longer cause crystal twitching.
The animation of Tap Succulents is smoother now, with no more jittering or model clipping.
Fixed the occasional volume error when adjusting volume.
Supplemented missing text.
Crystal Key can now push past the Coin Crystals, preventing the issue where Coin Crystals would fill up and block the production of keys.
Optimized the talent web layout, reducing the difficulty of accessing the Guide Tree.
Fixed the issue where lotus leaves couldn't be upgraded.
